verdict.rationale: Docs describe genuine parallel agent orchestration (grid of subagent cards, spinning up more agents while others run in background) and explicitly support multi-hour sessions, matching much of the story. However, evidence only confirms 'multi-hour' not multi-day autonomy, and community commentary raises skepticism about output quality/novelty without directly refuting the parallel-agent mechanics themselves. Missing for 10: confirmation of multi-day unattended runs, independent hands-on validation of fleet-scale parallel task completion.
